_help: Reverse fountain (Lightning giveaway) UI. enabled=false keeps the build byte-identical to a build without this feature: no widget, no /terms/ page, no privacy section, no footer link. The giveaway amount, budget and caps live in the Worker (wrangler.toml vars + admin endpoint), not here. api empty = use statues.json config.leaderboard_api. address_retention_days must match the Worker's FOUNTAIN_ADDRESS_RETENTION_DAYS. See FOUNTAIN.md.
